channel.title: Paksh: International
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Two Nations Ally with Saudi Arabia Against Houthi Attacks
item.description: Two nations have allied with Saudi Arabia to counter Houthi rebels, with a large plan reportedly in place to encircle them. In a related development, Houthi rebels launched a significant attack on two airports in Saudi Arabia, resulting in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: Ethiopia Conflict Escalates with Eritrean Troop Incursion
item.description: Eritrean troops have crossed into northern Ethiopia, escalating the ongoing conflict. The fighting is reportedly part of a larger, more extensive conflict. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Satellite Images Show Chinese Military Jets in Laos
item.description: Satellite images reveal Chinese military aircraft, including attack jets, have been stationed at a military facility in Laos. This development has prompted questions regarding China's expanding military presence and influence in the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Putin Escalates Warnings to Europe Over Ukraine Support
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin is increasingly issuing stark warnings to Europe, aiming to erode its support for Ukraine. These warnings involve "hybrid attacks and nuclear bluster," according to reporting. Putin's objective is to compel… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: US and China Discuss Reciprocal Nuclear Site Visits
item.description: The United States and China are reportedly discussing reciprocal visits to nuclear sites. This comes amid concerns about a potential new arms race between the two global powers. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Mali Junta Forces Retake Strategic Town of Kidal
item.description: Malian junta forces have retaken the strategic northern town of Kidal from separatist groups. Separatists had previously announced their withdrawal from the town. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Yemen Conflict and Civilian Displacement
item.description: Fighting continues in Yemen, forcing civilians to flee their homes. One family seeking refuge was observed in a shop in the city of Taiz. The ongoing conflict's specific combatants and broader implications remain subjects of inquiry. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: France Tests Nuclear-Capable Missile Without Warhead
item.description: France successfully test-fired a nuclear-capable missile without a payload, observed by President Emmanuel Macron. The launch was conducted without a warhead. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Iran trains women with firearms amid US tensions
item.description: In Iran, women are reportedly training with AK-47 rifles as part of preparations for a potential US ground invasion. This training is framed as a readiness to "sacrifice." The coverage indicates these actions are in response to perceived… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Makkah Alliance to Hold Emergency Talks on Houthi Attacks
item.description: Members of the Makkah defence alliance are scheduled to hold an emergency meeting in Riyadh to discuss engaging with the Houthis, following recent attacks. The alliance is reportedly considering how to address the ongoing Houthi actions. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: WHO Criticizes Delays in Aid Delivery to Gaza
item.description: The World Health Organization (WHO) has expressed strong disapproval of the delays in delivering essential aid into the Gaza Strip. The organization warns of potentially devastating consequences resulting from these hindrances. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Iraq Approves 40 Daily Flights for Iranian Airlines to Najaf
item.description: Iraq has granted Iranian airlines permission to operate 40 daily flights to and from the city of Najaf. This decision follows an exemption from U.S. sanctions that previously restricted such flights. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: China Expands Presence on Antelope Reef in South China Sea
item.description: Satellite images indicate that China is accelerating construction activities on Antelope Reef in the South China Sea. The latest imagery reveals a significant increase in the pace of work on the reef. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Zelenskyy Warns Countries as Russia Uses Foreign Recruits in Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has issued a warning to 47 countries, stating that Russia is employing foreign recruits in the ongoing war. Meanwhile, Russia has reportedly targeted Ukraine's data centers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 19 · Right 4.

item.title: Pakistan Airstrikes in Afghanistan Kill at Least 9
item.description: Pakistan conducted airstrikes in Afghanistan, resulting in the deaths of at least nine people, according to reports. The majority of those killed were women and children. One report stated that 22 people died in Helmand province as a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Rushes Patriot Missiles to Saudi, Qatar Amid Iran Tensions
item.description: The United States is deploying Patriot missile systems to Saudi Arabia and Qatar to safeguard oil and gas facilities amid heightened tensions with Iran. This deployment comes as the US perceives a potential for Iranian retaliation… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Troops Withdraw from Iraq After 12-Year Mission Against ISIS
item.description: The United States has completed the withdrawal of its troops from Iraq, concluding a 12-year mission focused on combating the Islamic State (ISIS). The operation, known as Operation Inherent Resolve, has officially ended. This withdrawal… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: Danish intelligence warns Russia may attack NATO country soon
item.description: Danish intelligence has warned that Russia could attack a NATO member country within months. The warning was issued by Denmark. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Turkey to transfer Bashiqa military base in Iraq to Baghdad
item.description: Turkey announced it will gradually transfer control of its Bashiqa military base in northern Iraq to the Iraqi government, according to a joint statement by the Turkish presidency and Baghdad. The handover follows progress in Iraqi… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: Iran Offers US New Peace Proposal, Ceasefire Plan
item.description: Iran has presented a new proposal for peace talks and a seven-day ceasefire to the Trump administration. The details of the proposal were not disclosed in the coverage. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: North Korea Rejects International Call to Halt Nuclear Tests
item.description: North Korea has rejected an international call to halt its nuclear tests. The country has not provided further details on its stance. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: China to send pandas back to Atlanta, Xi announces
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping announced that pandas will soon be sent to Atlanta. This move revives a diplomatic strategy, according to CNBC. The Print reported that Xi made the announcement regarding the pandas' return to Atlanta. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Nepal PM Praises India at UN, Proposes Himalaya Initiative
item.description: Nepal's Prime Minister Balen Shah addressed the United Nations, expressing strong praise for India and proposing an initiative related to the Himalayas. The specific details of the proposal were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
